top_signals.title: Brent Crude Climbs Back Above $96 as Iran Tensions Escalate
top_signals.summary: Oil prices bounced back in early trading on Friday as geopolitical risk returns and optimism surrounding potential peace deals fades. Friday, November 6, 2026The initial days of the US’ post-midterms price collapse are gradually making way for a return to the pre-November status quo, with President Trump insinuating that he ‘doesn’t need a deal with Iran’ amidst intensifying Israeli pressure to resume military strikes against Tehran. top_signals.title: Iran Braces for a Budget Without Oil Revenue
top_signals.summary: Iran is drafting next year’s budget under the premise that oil revenue could fall to zero, with senior budget official Mohammad Ghasemi telling the government on Monday to prepare for that scenario, as the country appears to be weeks away from that eventuality. Iran has loaded no crude since August 25, according to the US Treasury, and the oil it held at sea outside the US blockade fell from 88.8 million barrels in mid-July to zero by mid-October.
